valueString.value: NL-PS niveau 4b: bearer token van je eigen systeem voor je testpatiënt niveau 4b

title.value: NL-PS-REG-L4B - Regressie niveau 4b: 2 maximale GBB's per sectie (NL) - Fixed token per patient - XML Format

description.value: Regressietest: alleen testgevallen met testsoort Regressie (M-eisen, geautomatiseerd). Een fout laat de test falen. Testpatiënt niveau 4b (TP-4b). Conformancelab stuurt het bearer token mee dat je bij de testopzet invoert; gebruik een token dat alleen toegang geeft tot je testpatiënt niveau 4b. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ en generieke bouwblokken https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/. Traceability: PS-requirements v0.1 en het tabblad Testgevallen.
De id van de eerste PS-Composition in het zoekresultaat.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).first().id

description.value: TG-02-01: zoek de PS-Composition van de testpatiënt.
TG-02-01: GET [base]/Composition?type=http://loinc.org|60591-5
TG-02-01 (PS-API-04): Confirm that the server responds with HTTP status 200.
TG-02-01 (PS-API-04): het antwoord is een searchset-Bundle.

expression.value: Bundle.type = 'searchset'

description.value: TG-02-01 (PS-API-04): het zoekresultaat bevat minimaal één Composition.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).exists()

description.value: TG-02-01 (PS-API-04): elke gevonden Composition is een Patient Summary (LOINC 60591-5).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Composition).all(type.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '60591-5').exists())

description.value: TG-02-05, TG-03-01 t/m TG-03-04, TG-03-07: haal de PS op als document en valideer Bundle en Composition.
TG-02-05: GET [base]/Composition/[id]/$document
TG-02-05 (PS-API-07): Confirm that the server responds with HTTP status 200.
TG-02-05 (PS-API-07): het antwoord is een Bundle.
TG-03-01 (PS-API-07): de Bundle is een document; een searchset-wrapper wordt niet geaccepteerd.

expression.value: Bundle.type = 'document'

description.value: TG-03-02 (PS-API-08): de eerste entry is een Composition.
TG-03-02 (PS-API-08): de Composition is een Patient Summary (LOINC 60591-5).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).type.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '60591-5').exists()

description.value: TG-03-03 (PS-API-09): het document heeft een identifier met system en value, en een timestamp.

expression.value: Bundle.identifier.system.exists() and Bundle.identifier.value.exists() and Bundle.timestamp.exists()

description.value: TG-03-04 (PS-API-10): de Bundle conformeert aan http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/bundle-eu-eps.

TG-03-07 (PS-HDR-01): de Composition conformeert aan nl-PatientSummary en via imposeProfile aan composition-eu-eps; dekt ook TG-03-21 t/m TG-03-23 (cmp-1, cmp-2, ips-comp-1), TG-03-27 (required bindings) en de XHTML-geldigheid van TG-03-26.
TG-03-05/06/08/09/11 t/m 15/17, op het document uit de vorige test.
TG-03-05 (PS-API-11): elke referentie in het document is binnen het document oplosbaar (fullUrl of [type]/[id]).

expression.value: Bundle.descendants().where($this is Reference).reference.where(startsWith('#').not()).distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/([A-Za-z]+/[^/]+)$', '$1')))

description.value: TG-03-06 (PS-API-12): het document bevat precies één Patient.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Patient).count() = 1

description.value: TG-03-06 (PS-API-12): alle subject- en patient-referenties in het document verwijzen naar die ene Patient.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.select(subject | patient).reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is Patient).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Patient/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Patient/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-03-08 (PS-HDR-02): de Composition heeft een identifier met system en value.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).identifier.system.exists() and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).identifier.value.exists()

description.value: TG-03-09 (PS-HDR-03): de Composition heeft een geldige status.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).status in ('preliminary' | 'final' | 'amended' | 'entered-in-error')

description.value: TG-03-11 (PS-HDR-04): Composition.subject verwijst naar de Patient in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).subject.reference in %resource.entry.where(resource is Patient).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Patient/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Patient/' + resource.id))

description.value: TG-03-12 (PS-HDR-05): de Composition heeft een datum.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).date.exists()

description.value: TG-03-13 (PS-HDR-06): de Composition heeft minimaal één auteur, en elke auteur is in het document oplosbaar.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).author.count() >= 1 and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).author.reference.subsetOf(%resource.entry.select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/([A-Za-z]+/[^/]+)$', '$1')))

description.value: TG-03-14 (PS-HDR-07): de Composition heeft een niet-lege titel.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).title.exists() and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).title.length() > 0

description.value: TG-03-15 (PS-HDR-15): de Patient conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Patient.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Patient/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).resource

description.value: TG-03-17 (PS-HDR-16): de Patient heeft minimaal één identifier met een waarde.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Patient/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).resource.identifier.where(value.exists()).exists()

description.value: TG-03-19 (PS-SEC-01): sectie Problemen (LOINC 11450-4) komt precies één keer voor.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).count() = 1

description.value: TG-03-19 (PS-SEC-01): sectie Allergieën en intoleranties (LOINC 48765-2) komt precies één keer voor.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).count() = 1

description.value: TG-03-19 (PS-SEC-01): sectie Medicatieoverzicht (LOINC 10160-0) komt precies één keer voor.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '10160-0').exists()).count() = 1

description.value: TG-03-19 (PS-SEC-01): sectie Verrichtingen (LOINC 47519-4) komt precies één keer voor.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).count() = 1

description.value: TG-03-19 (PS-SEC-01): sectie Medische hulpmiddelen (LOINC 46264-8) komt precies één keer voor.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).count() = 1

description.value: TG-03-20 (PS-SEC-02): elke sectie heeft een titel, een code en een narrative.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.all(title.exists() and code.exists() and text.exists())

description.value: TG-03-21 (PS-SEC-03): geen sectie is inhoudsloos (cmp-1).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.all(text.exists() or entry.exists() or section.exists())

description.value: TG-03-22 (PS-SEC-04): een emptyReason staat alleen bij een sectie zonder entries (cmp-2).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.all(emptyReason.empty() or entry.empty())

description.value: TG-03-23 (PS-SEC-05): Problemen, Allergieën en Medicatie hebben entries of een emptyReason (ips-comp-1).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code in ('11450-4' | '48765-2' | '10160-0')).exists()).all(entry.reference.exists() or emptyReason.exists())

description.value: TG-03-24 (PS-SEC-07): sectie Medicatieoverzicht is aanwezig, zonder entries, met emptyReason en narrative.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '10160-0').exists()).exists() and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '10160-0').exists()).all(entry.empty() and emptyReason.exists() and text.exists())

description.value: TG-03-26 (PS-NAR-01): elke sectie-narrative heeft een geldige status en een niet-lege div.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.all(text.status in ('generated' | 'extensions' | 'additional') and text.`div`.exists())

description.value: TG-07-01 (PS-ENT-01): sectie Problemen heeft minimaal één entry.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.count() >= 1

description.value: TG-07-02 (PS-SEC-09): elke entry van sectie Problemen verwijst naar een Condition in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is Condition).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de Condition van de eerste entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Condition.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('Condition/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-05 (PS-ENT-05): elke Condition in sectie Problemen heeft code, subject, onset[x] en recordedDate.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(code.exists() and subject.exists() and onset.exists() and recordedDate.exists())

description.value: TG-07-10 (PS-NAR-02): de narrative van sectie Problemen noemt elk Condition (code.text of display).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de Condition van de tweede entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Condition.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[1].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[1].reference or ('Condition/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[1].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-09-01 (PS-ENT-02): sectie Problemen heeft minimaal twee entries met onderling verschillende referenties.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.count() >= 2 and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.isDistinct()

description.value: TG-09-02 (PS-NAR-05): de ene narrative van sectie Problemen noemt minimaal twee Condition-entries.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.where(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this))).count() >= 2

description.value: TG-07-01/02/03, TG-07-06, TG-07-10, TG-09-01, TG-09-02: sectie Allergieën en intoleranties (LOINC 48765-2).
TG-07-01 (PS-ENT-01): sectie Allergieën en intoleranties heeft minimaal één entry.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.count() >= 1

description.value: TG-07-02 (PS-SEC-09): elke entry van sectie Allergieën en intoleranties verwijst naar een AllergyIntolerance in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de AllergyIntolerance van de eerste entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-AllergyIntolerance.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-06 (PS-ENT-07): elke AllergyIntolerance in sectie Allergieën en intoleranties heeft clinicalStatus, code, patient en per reaction manifestation en onset.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(clinicalStatus.exists() and code.exists() and patient.exists() and reaction.all(manifestation.exists() and onset.exists()))

description.value: TG-07-10 (PS-NAR-02): de narrative van sectie Allergieën en intoleranties noemt elk AllergyIntolerance (code.text of display).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de AllergyIntolerance van de tweede entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-AllergyIntolerance.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[1].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[1].reference or ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry[1].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-09-01 (PS-ENT-02): sectie Allergieën en intoleranties heeft minimaal twee entries met onderling verschillende referenties.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.count() >= 2 and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.isDistinct()

description.value: TG-09-02 (PS-NAR-05): de ene narrative van sectie Allergieën en intoleranties noemt minimaal twee AllergyIntolerance-entries.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is AllergyIntolerance and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(AllergyIntolerance/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('AllergyIntolerance/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.where(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '48765-2').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this))).count() >= 2

description.value: TG-07-01/02/03, TG-07-07, TG-07-10, TG-09-01, TG-09-02: sectie Verrichtingen (LOINC 47519-4).
TG-07-01 (PS-ENT-01): sectie Verrichtingen heeft minimaal één entry.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.count() >= 1

description.value: TG-07-02 (PS-SEC-09): elke entry van sectie Verrichtingen verwijst naar een Procedure in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is Procedure).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Procedure/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Procedure/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de Procedure van de eerste entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Procedure.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Procedure and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Procedure/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('Procedure/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-07 (PS-ENT-09): elke Procedure in sectie Verrichtingen heeft status, code en subject.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Procedure and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Procedure/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Procedure/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(status.exists() and code.exists() and subject.exists())

description.value: TG-07-10 (PS-NAR-02): de narrative van sectie Verrichtingen noemt elk Procedure (code.text of display).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Procedure and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Procedure/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Procedure/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de Procedure van de tweede entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Procedure.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Procedure and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry[1].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Procedure/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry[1].reference or ('Procedure/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry[1].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-09-01 (PS-ENT-02): sectie Verrichtingen heeft minimaal twee entries met onderling verschillende referenties.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.count() >= 2 and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.reference.isDistinct()

description.value: TG-09-02 (PS-NAR-05): de ene narrative van sectie Verrichtingen noemt minimaal twee Procedure-entries.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Procedure and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Procedure/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Procedure/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.where(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '47519-4').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this))).count() >= 2

description.value: TG-07-01/02/03, TG-07-08, TG-09-01: sectie Medische hulpmiddelen (LOINC 46264-8).
TG-07-01 (PS-ENT-01): sectie Medische hulpmiddelen heeft minimaal één entry.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.count() >= 1

description.value: TG-07-02 (PS-SEC-09): elke entry van sectie Medische hulpmiddelen verwijst naar een DeviceUseStatement in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de DeviceUseStatement van de eerste entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-DeviceUse.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-08 (PS-ENT-11): elke DeviceUseStatement in sectie Medische hulpmiddelen heeft status, subject en device.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(status.exists() and subject.exists() and device.exists())

description.value: TG-07-08 (PS-ENT-11): elk DeviceUseStatement.device verwijst naar een Device in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.device.reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is Device).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Device/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Device/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de DeviceUseStatement van de tweede entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-DeviceUse.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is DeviceUseStatement and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[1].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(DeviceUseStatement/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[1].reference or ('DeviceUseStatement/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry[1].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-09-01 (PS-ENT-02): sectie Medische hulpmiddelen heeft minimaal twee entries met onderling verschillende referenties.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.count() >= 2 and Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '46264-8').exists()).entry.reference.isDistinct()

description.value: TG-07-09 (PS-ENT-13): geen Condition, AllergyIntolerance, Procedure of DeviceUseStatement met (verification)status entered-in-error.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where(($this is Condition or $this is AllergyIntolerance) and verificationStatus.coding.code contains 'entered-in-error').empty() and Bundle.entry.resource.where(($this is Procedure or $this is DeviceUseStatement) and status = 'entered-in-error').empty()

description.value: TG-08-05 (PS-ENT-14): bij een bodySite met NL-extensie (bodySite → BodyStructure) is het EPS-element bodySite zelf ook gevuld (coding of text).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.resource.where($this is Condition or $this is Procedure).bodySite.where(extension.where(url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/bodySite').exists()).all(coding.exists() or text.exists())

description.value: TG-08-07 (PS-SEC-08): elke niet-verplichte sectie heeft een EPS-sectiecode (LOINC), een titel en een narrative; volledige slice-validatie loopt via TG-03-07.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code in ('11450-4' | '48765-2' | '10160-0' | '47519-4' | '46264-8')).empty()).all(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code in ('11369-6' | '30954-2' | '42348-3' | '104605-1' | '47420-5' | '10162-6' | '81338-6' | '18776-5' | '29762-2' | '8716-3' | '10182-4' | '11329-0')).exists() and title.exists() and text.exists())
